description: The user changed in Settings which evaluator checks one box of a choice point, or how its answers are shown: the box's settings, whole.

field.description: The box of the choice point: away, towards, situation, or thoughts (thoughts and feelings).

evaluator.description: The evaluator that checks each line of the box; null for none, so the box is not checked.

questions.description: How each of the evaluator's questions is shown, in the evaluator's order; a question left out is not shown.

items.description: How one of the evaluator's questions is shown.

id.description: The evaluator's question this setting is for.

show.description: Whether the question's answer is shown as a mark next to the line.

expect.description: The answer expected: green when Jev gives it, red when not; null when no answer is expected, so the mark has no colour. An option id, or yes or no for a yes / no question.

when.description: Show the mark only when another question of the box got this answer; null for always.

option.description: An answer of the question: the id of a pick question's option, or yes or no for a yes / no question.

icons.description: The icon each answer gets, by option id (or yes / no). auto: a check when the answer is the expected one and a warning when not; none: no icon. An answer left out is auto.

also.description: Further evaluators that check each line of the box as well as evaluator, in order; empty or absent for none.

items.description: One further evaluator of the box and how its answers are shown.

questions.description: How each of the further evaluator's questions is shown, in its order; a question left out is not shown. Empty for an evaluator shown as one mark (combined), whose every question counts.

items.description: How one of the evaluator's questions is shown.

id.description: The evaluator's question this setting is for.

show.description: Whether the question's answer is shown as a mark next to the line.

expect.description: The answer expected: green when Jev gives it, red when not; null when no answer is expected, so the mark has no colour. An option id, or yes or no for a yes / no question.

when.description: Show the mark only when another question of the box got this answer; null for always.

option.description: An answer of the question: the id of a pick question's option, or yes or no for a yes / no question.

icons.description: The icon each answer gets, by option id (or yes / no). auto: a check when the answer is the expected one and a warning when not; none: no icon. An answer left out is auto.
